dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent O and C shaped structures exhibit high-contrast white perimeters with irregular, serrated edges. A gradient transition is visible from a bright exterior border to a darker, textured interior core, specifically in the three largest central-dorsal rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High-intensity white pixel clusters are situated at the intersections of annular structures and within their interior cores. Spatial density is concentrated in the mid-lateral section of the torso.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the dorsal-midsection form a scalene triangle. A secondary set of smaller high-intensity blobs forms a trapezoidal geometric relationship in the posterior-lateral region.

other_distinctive_markers: A nested pattern in the mid-flank features a small, high-intensity ring fully enclosed within the boundary of a larger, more diffuse light-toned annulus.
